method: Deterministic weighted overlap of distinctive tokens from short independently worded action labels; min 2 shared, weighted Dice>=0.31, 5 top candidates per observation. This method misses synonyms, makes false positives from identical feasts/materials, and cannot establish practice identity or source independence. Excerpt pages by same author and quotation in compilations are not independent attestation.

manual_review_priority_examples.note: Wreath reuse across Mueller, Weiser, Stokes and McLoughlin is plausible; compare specific actions and authors' evidence.
Saint John's ceremonial blessed wine needs separation from other wine observances and an authoritative ritual-source check.
Polish opłatek is explicit in Kelly; compare Weiser and Stokes for derivative wording instead of assuming independent corroboration.
